title: Ami bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Keritot 20a](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.20a.11), “Ami bar Avin and Rav Chananya bar Avin both say,” and so on. Some read Abaye bar Avin there. Hyman also cites Ami bar Avin in [Shabbat 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.20b.15).[^1]

notes.text: The joint statement continues on [Keritot 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.20b.1). The consulted Shabbat text reads Rami bar Avin. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=571&lang=en) records Rami and proposes Rabbi Ami instead. Hyman’s reported Abaye reading in Keritot remains a distinct variant.
